name: vinto-release
description: Release tooling that runs from the repo ROOT: zdymak (store screenshots, App Preview, Play feature graphic) and vydanne (App Store Connect / Google Play listing, declarations, compliance, build upload). Root, not a subfolder — both tools resolve their config and every relative path inside it against the working directory, so `npm run` from anywhere else silently reads the wrong paths. The COMPLETE surface is wired on purpose: an ad-hoc `npx vydanne` is how two commands stayed broken for months elsewhere in the portfolio. The Gradle build is unaffected; this file adds nothing to it.

scripts.play:internal: node tools/check-release-branch.mjs && VYDANNE_TRACK=internal vydanne prerelease --store google
scripts.capture-ios: node ../zdymak/bin/zdymak.mjs capture --platform ios --device "iPhone 17 Pro Max" --bundle app.kupalinka.vinto --arg -vinto.capture --states home,teach,table,score,lobby,plan --settle 45 --out ./marketing/captures/ios
scripts.capture-ipad: node ../zdymak/bin/zdymak.mjs capture --platform ios --device "iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)" --bundle app.kupalinka.vinto --arg -vinto.capture --states home,teach,table,score,lobby,plan --settle 45 --out ./marketing/captures/ios-ipad
scripts.capture-iap: npm run capture-headless && zdymak screenshots && vydanne iap
